verdict.rationale: Square has date-based API versioning: the Node SDK lets callers override the version per request (e.g. version: "2024-05-04"), and the MCP server documents SQUARE_VERSION pinning. Nothing in the evidence documents a deprecation policy, retirement timelines, or version lifecycle guarantees, so only half the story is shown. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, version lifecycle and changelog documentation, and independent corroboration of version stability.
